THE PRESIDENT 7145
EXECUTIVE ORDER 11665
James F . Byrnes
As a mark o f respect to the memory o f James F. Byrnes, it is hereby 
ordered, pursuant to the provisions o f Section 4 o f Proclam ation 3044 
o f M arch 1, 1954, as amended, that until interment the flag of the 
U nited States shall be flow n at half-staff on all buildings, grounds and 
naval vessels o f the Federal Government in the District o f Columbia 
and throughout the U nited States and its Territories and possessions. I  
also direct that the flag shall be flow n at half-staff fo r the same length 
o f time at all U nited States embassies, legations, consular offices, and 
other facilities abroad, including all m ilitary facilities and naval vessels 
and stations.
